summary: Wall St bounced Wednesday (S&P +1.3%, Nasdaq +1.6%) on CoreWeave's beat reviving the AI trade, a day after hot October CPI pushed December Fed hike odds to ~91% and the dollar to ~102. Bonds were shut for Veterans Day; oil kept sliding on US-Iran peace hopes and gold slipped.
events_next_24h: US Treasury market reopens after Veterans Day: first bond reaction since Wednesday's rally
Check Forex Factory manually: calendar feed blocked this run
tier1_next_14d: No FOMC or BOJ decision in the window (next FOMC 8-9 Dec, BOJ 18 Dec); PCE (Oct) date unconfirmed, calendar dataset unreadable this run

ES.why: S&P +1.3% on the AI rebound and funds sit mid-range (35th pct), but ~91% Fed hike odds after hot CPI cap the upside.
ES.risk: Yields jump when bonds reopen or the AI rally fades.

NQ.why: Nasdaq +1.6% on CoreWeave, but funds are crowded long (98th pct) and a near-certain Dec Fed hike hurts tech valuations.
NQ.risk: Clean follow-through on AI names, or a crowded-long unwind if yields spike.

YM.why: Dow lagged (+0.5%) as the bounce was tech-led; rate-hike pricing offsets the risk-on tone.
YM.risk: Broadening rally into value or a yield spike.

RTY.why: Small caps rose 0.9% but are the most hurt by a Fed hike, now ~91% priced for December.
RTY.risk: Yields fall when bonds reopen, or hike odds firm further.

NKD.why: Nikkei rose 1.4% to 61,298 for a third straight gain and US AI stocks rallied overnight; fund positioning is neutral (46th pct).
NKD.risk: Yen surge on BoJ/intervention talk or AI stocks reverse.

6E.why: Hot US CPI and ~91% Dec Fed hike odds keep the dollar firm near 102 on the index, a headwind for the euro.
6E.risk: Soft US data or a dovish Fed speaker cools hike bets.

6J.why: Fed hike bets favour the dollar, but USD/JPY near 158 is close to Japan's intervention zone and a Dec BoJ hike is expected.
6J.risk: Break toward 160 sparks intervention (yen up), or BoJ signals a delay (yen down).

6B.why: Dollar firm on Fed hike pricing but risk-on mood helps; no clear UK driver found this run.
6B.risk: UK data surprise or a sharp USD move.

6A.why: Risk-on equities support the Aussie while a firm dollar on Fed hike bets weighs; signals cancel out.
6A.risk: A strong risk-on follow-through or a USD spike.

ZN.why: Hot Oct CPI pushed yields up and Fed hike odds to ~91%; bonds were shut Wednesday while stocks rallied.
ZN.risk: Soft data or a dovish Fed voice pulls hike odds back.

GC.why: Gold fell 0.9% to about $3,995 as hike bets and a firm dollar weigh; funds already lean short (21st pct), limiting downside.
GC.risk: Iran talks collapse or yields drop, sparking a short squeeze.

CL.why: Oil keeps sliding on US-Iran peace hopes (WTI ~$86), but funds are crowded short (10th pct) and talks keep stalling.
CL.risk: Talks break down (squeeze up) or a deal is signed (more downside).
